finding: UnifiedDB must carry server-binary/state lineage, embodiment, API session/provenance, typed person/client relations, and exact ClayCode call-contract/runtime-binding/effect receipts as separate semantics. Q23 experience evidence must preserve independent episode ancestry and dose N rather than duplicate-frame counts.
boundaries: UnifiedDB remains semantic authority; ClayGraph/API/session associations do not merge identities or mint effect authority.
Frank access to ResearchDB is governed bridge access, not identity merge or canonical research mutation.
counterhypotheses: Additional identity/API/call-contract state may raise maintenance cost without end-to-end benefit.
Experience-dose gains may be generic context/cache effects exposed by SHAM_N controls.
